snippet.title: Super Mario Meltdown - Release Trailer | Download (SM64 ROM Hack)
snippet.description:
⬇️ Download :
• RHDC Link : https://romhacking.com/hack/super-mario-meltdown

• OST Playlist : https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLb2XGUjqWY2c_NT7h6ZQjWDX_Cy-AkBPQ

🌟🌟🌟
Super Mario Meltdown is a ROM hack of Super Mario 64 featuring 60 Power Stars!
Face a threatening Bowser who seeks to open evil portals across the Mushroom Kingdom using the power of the Stars!
Collect all 60 Power Stars to stop him and save the kingdom!
Explore over 30 unique and varied maps, with custom and original mechanics!
All of it backed by immersive music to fully draw you into the world of Super Mario Meltdown.
Princess Peach is waiting for you!
🌟🌟🌟

💻 How to play the game and apply BPS Files : 
Apply the .bps file to the correct base ROM using "Flips" (Floating IPS).

Tested on Project64 2.2.0.3:
If you play on Project64, set RDRAM size to 8MB in Settings/Config, set Counter Factor to 1, then reset the game to avoid black screen.
If your video plugin is Jabo's Direct3D, to avoid broken alpha textures, go to Configure Graphics/Advanced and check "Force legacy pixel pipeline".

Have fun!
